lines.text: A friendly guy knows a cheap bar.|Don't follow him.
Pick your own bar.|Check the price first.
A bar with the price|on the door.
Then I sat down|and ordered like a local.
One drink. One bill.|Nine thirty yen.
Five hundred dollars,|or nine-thirty yen. Your call.
The tout isn't your friend.|He's paid per customer|he brings inside.
A cheap drink can cost|fifty thousand yen.|Check the price first.
Walk in yourself —|the price on the door|is the price.
That's Japan first times.|Follow for more.
